verses.text: Sb'ochajpax junok altar t'a te' chemte' nab'a acacia, lajannhej tz'aj yechel schanhil pak'anh. Chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro tz'aj junjun pak'anh, jun metro yet' 25 centímetro tz'aj schaanhil.
Sb'ochajk'e junjun sch'aak t'a junjun schikintak. Ha juntzanh sch'aak chi' yaman tz'aj yet' jun altar chi', spichchaj te' t'a k'een bronce.

Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il altar chi', nab'a bronceokabi: Haton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab', k'een tenedor yet' pax yet'tal b'aj tz'em te tzak'ak'.
Sb'opax junok k'een malla nab'a bronce, tz'ochpax junjun argolla bronce t'a junjun yesquinail k'een.
Tz'elk'och k'een yesquinail chi' t'a spatiktak jun altar chi' t'a yalanh jun oyanoch t'a stitak. Ha k'een malla chi', t'a snanhal jun altar chi' sb'ojiem k'een.
Sb'opax juntzanhok sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi'. Ha te' acacia tz'ochi, tz'ochpax bronce t'a spatik te'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il chi', yowalil tzek' te' t'a yol k'een argolla ayoch t'a schab'il pak'anh yik wach' sb'akhjib'ati.
Ha jun altar chi', olan tz'ajkan yool, icha yechel ix in ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik.

Sb'ochajpax k'apak cortina lino te wach' b'ayb'il, yik tz'och hoyan smakulok yamaq'uil ay t'a spatiktak in kajnub' chi'. Ha t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal sur, 45 metro tz'ajb'at t'inhan k'apak cortina chi'.
Tz'och 20 te' oy, 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce, haxo t'a schon junjun te' oy chi', tz'em jun k'een nab'a plata ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay.

Icha pax chi' t'a stojolal norte, yowalil tz'ochpax k'apak cortina t'a sk'atul chi' smasanil. 45 metro tz'aji, 20 pax te' yoyal tz'ochi yet' 20 sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce, tz'em jun k'een nab'a plata, ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay t'a schon junjun te' oy chi'.
Haxo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, a k'apak cortina tz'och t'ay, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj sat yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax lajunhe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a jun amak' chi', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat. Tz'ochpax k'apak cortina t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh sti' amak' chi', ay uke' metro k'apak cortina tz'ochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Hanheja' t'a junxo pak'anh sti', ay pax uke' metro k'apak cortina tz'ochi, ay oxe' oy yet' oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.

Haxo t'a sti' amak' chi', hata' sb'ojioch junok k'apak cortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il, nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak. Sb'oji yelwanub' k'apak yuj junok jelan sb'oani. Ha t'a anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al sb'ochaj yelwanub' chi'.
Masanil te' oy t'a spatik yichanh amak' chi', tz'em k'een k'een nab'a plata ayoch argolla t'ay t'a schon te'. Haxo pax sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a bronce.

Ha jun amak' chi', 45 metro sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, lajannhej schapak'anhil. Haxo pax k'apak cortina ayk'e t'a chaanh, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro steel k'apak. Ha k'apak cortina chi', haton lino wach' b'ayb'il. Haxo sb'akhnub' yich te oy chi', nab'a bronce.
Masanil yestacail in kajnub' chi' yet' estaca ayoch t'a amak' chi', nab'a bronce tz'aji.
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot aceite heb', haton aceite wach' tz'el t'a sat te' olivo, yik wach' aynhej yaceiteal juntzanh candil.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ayoch t'a yib'anh sb'oanoch sk'ak'al candil chi', yik wach' kopanel sk'ak'al t'a wichanh tzek' ak'wal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina ayoch yenhulok te' skaxail in trato. Ha jun tik, junelnhej ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik yet' pax t'a heb' eyinhtilal.
